- Lyrics word by word, even syllable by syllable, when the song has them: LRCLIB's word-timed records ("hasWordSync") and NetEase as a second source (Settings > Lyrics > Extra source). Each word fills as it is sung; a song without word times follows its lines, then shows plain text. Lyrics kept beside a song with line times only get their words in the background (kept by the app; the song's file is not touched). The lyric info line says Word by word, Line by line or Plain text.
- A smaller app: the default APK is 64-bit only; the release has a separate 32-bit APK (Pulse-<version>-32bit.apk, lite) for old phones, and the updater picks the right one. 68 of the 74 bundled Winamp skins are now "More Winamp skins" in the Extra store (3 MB). Chinese, Japanese and Korean PDF character maps are left out (a PDF with those fonts shows no text from them in the book reader). The 209 launcher icons are WebP (0.65 MB less).
- Glass launcher icons: dark Material glass in the colours of the example, Pulse's own is a pulse in a ring.
